name: but

phase_0.boundary_condition: set of all well-formed logical propositions

VINIT.justification: the void state before any logical content is asserted

TANCH.justification: the closed boundary containing all possible propositions and truth values

AFWD.justification: forward directed relation from antecedent to consequent

AREV.justification: reverse descent that modifies or qualifies the forward direction

CLINK.justification: sequential chaining of logical propositions, the core operation of but

IMSCRIB.justification: self-identity of a proposition that is true under all interpretations

FSPLIT.justification: splits a compound proposition into two contrasting sub-propositions, e.g., P but Q into P and Q

FFUSE.justification: reunites the two sub-propositions into the original compound with contrast preserved

EVALT.justification: the affirmative thesis in the but construction

EVALF.justification: the contrasting antithesis in the but construction

ENGAGR.justification: both clauses held simultaneously without resolution, the paradice of but

IFIX.justification: the permanent record of the logical statement after fixing its truth conditions

phase_3.both_description: 11: paradoxical state where both P and not-P are held simultaneously, akin to the but tension

steps.domain_action: close the logical universe as the domain of discourse
self-reference of the empty set, establishing a placeholder
forward morphism introduces the first proposition P as a thesis
split the thesis into two branching paths: P and a contrasting Q
on T-arm, affirm P as true
on F-arm, apply qualification to produce the contrasting Q (parity flip from expectation)
compose the two branches into a combined expression
reunite the branches into the compound P but Q
hold both P and Q simultaneously without resolution
record the permanent theorem P but Q as a fixed logical statement

phase_5.compiler_frontend: assertion engine that instantiates propositions from syntax
phase_5.ipc_mechanism: truth-value propagation along edges between nodes
phase_5.memory_mechanism: propositional store indexed by semantic role
phase_5.scheduler_mechanism: linear order of evaluation within the but construction
phase_5.alfs_store: the canonical set of well-formed formulae in classical logic

phase_6.pre_cycle_state: void state, no assigned truth values
phase_6.post_cycle_state: state with two propositions and a compound truth value (both 11)
phase_6.delta_s_verdict: ΔS ≈ 0 — no information is destroyed; the split and fuse preserve the original content
